levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ ... قَالا» is one level; «أبي» is a bare relation
two «جميعا» convergences are written as two co-transmitter levels, in the text's order; no ح, so one group
«سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ع يَقُولُ» makes the Imam the last link (owner ruling 2); the blessings are dropped
